decision: certificate evidence is opportunistic, never required
why: TLS 1.3 encrypts the Certificate message, so x509sat.* is empty on modern connections
evidence: curl https://example.com -> handshake types 1,2 only; with --tls-max 1.2 -> types 1,2,11,12,14,16 and uTF8String carries example.com
result: identity must fall back to SNI/DNS/Host and must not invent a name

decision: x509af.subject and x509af.issuer are unusable as names
why: they return numeric OID lists, not strings
result: readable names come from x509sat.uTF8String / printableString
